declarations.bibleVerseText: No one lights a lamp and hides it in a clay jar or puts it under a bed.

declarations.text: I deny myself, take up my cross, and follow Christ. That surrender is not loss. It is the path to the life that is truly life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.

declarations.text: I choose the better thing. I sit at the feet of Jesus. In a world of endless demands, I guard my time with Him as sacred.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her.

declarations.text: I ask and I receive. I seek and I find. I knock and the door opens. My Father gives the Holy Spirit to all who ask Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!

declarations.text: I am not anxious about tomorrow. I seek the kingdom first and everything else is added to me. God knows what I need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.

declarations.text: I am like a mustard seed. What God plants in me grows beyond all natural proportion. His kingdom within me is unstoppable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds perched in its branches.

declarations.text: I am found. God searches for me with relentless joy. He does not rest until I am secure in His arms.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders and goes home.

declarations.text: My Father runs to meet me. He does not walk. He sees me from a distance and He runs. I am always welcomed home.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.

declarations.text: I am clothed in the best robe. I am restored to full sonship. My Father celebrates my return with unrestrained joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.

declarations.text: I use the resources God has entrusted to me with wisdom and generosity. I am a faithful steward who builds eternal wealth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

declarations.text: My faith moves mountains. Even faith the size of a mustard seed commands the impossible and it obeys. God has given me that faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it will obey you.

declarations.text: I come before God in humility, not pride. He exalts those who humble themselves. I am lifted up by His sovereign, gracious hand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.

declarations.text: I receive the kingdom of God like a child. Simple trust. Open hands. Undivided reliance. That is how I enter and how I remain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.

declarations.text: I have received the right to be called a child of God. That is not a title I earned. It is a birthright I received.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.

declarations.text: In the beginning was the Word. He became flesh and dwelt among men. That Word dwells in me and transforms everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

declarations.text: Life itself is in Jesus. That life is the light of every person. I carry that light because I carry Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.

declarations.text: True worship flows from the Spirit, not from ritual. I am a worshiper who bows in spirit and in truth. That is what the Father seeks.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.

declarations.text: Doing God's will is not a burden to me. It is the very thing that sustains and satisfies me from the inside out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

declarations.text: God did not send Jesus into the world to condemn me. He sent Him to save me. I am not under judgment. I am under grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.

declarations.text: Jesus is the Way, the Truth, and the Life. There is no other path to the Father. I walk through Him and Him alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus answered, 'I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'

declarations.text: I am sealed in eternal life right now. I believe in the Son. The Father's sovereign decree stands over me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For my Father's will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life.

declarations.text: Darkness does not overcome the light. The light shines and keeps shining. I carry that inextinguishable light in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

declarations.text: Jesus calls me by name. He leads me out. I am not anonymous to my Shepherd. He knows me and I know His voice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

declarations.text: The Son has set me free. Completely free. Not partially, not conditionally. I am free indeed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

declarations.text: I am not condemned by what I was born into. The works of God are displayed in me. My story carries His glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither this man nor his parents sinned, said Jesus, but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.

declarations.text: Jesus is the Good Shepherd and He knows me. I am not a number in a crowd. I am known, named, and tended by Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me.

declarations.text: I hear the voice of Jesus. I know it and I follow it. No counterfeit voice has authority over my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

declarations.text: My heart is not troubled. I trust God. I trust Jesus. I live from a place of anchored, settled belief.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.

declarations.text: Jesus has prepared a place for me in the Father's house. I am expected. I am welcomed. I belong.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My Father's house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

declarations.text: Jesus does not leave me as an orphan. He comes to me. I am not abandoned. I am held.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

declarations.text: Jesus has given me His peace. Not a fragile peace. A peace the world cannot manufacture or take away.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives.

declarations.text: I abide in the love of Jesus. His love for me mirrors the Father's love for Him. I am held in the deepest love that exists.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.

declarations.text: Eternal life is not just quantity of years. It is depth of knowing. I know the Father and the Son. That knowing is my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.

declarations.text: I love others as Jesus loved me. That is how the world recognizes I am His disciple. My love is the living proof.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.

declarations.text: Everything the Father has is mine in Christ. The Spirit takes what belongs to Jesus and reveals it to me. I am not impoverished.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.

declarations.text: I ask in Jesus' name and I receive. My joy is made complete through asking. I come boldly before the throne.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.

declarations.text: The Father Himself loves me because I love Jesus and believe He came from God. I stand in that love permanently.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

declarations.text: I serve Jesus by following Him. Wherever He is, I am there with Him. The Father honors those who serve His Son.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.

declarations.text: I bring glory to the Father by bearing fruit that lasts. My life is a testimony of His sovereign power at work in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

declarations.text: No greater love exists than laying down one's life for a friend. Jesus did that for me. I am the friend He died for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends.

declarations.text: I remain in Jesus and He remains in me. That is where my fruitfulness comes from. That is where my life is rooted.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine.

declarations.text: Jesus prayed that I would carry His full joy within me. That joy is not circumstantial. It is a dwelling gift from Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.

declarations.text: I am in Jesus and He is in me. We are brought into complete unity with the Father. That oneness is not symbolic. It is real.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I in them and you in me so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me.

declarations.text: Jesus has sent me into the world just as the Father sent Him. I carry a divine commission. I go with His authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Again Jesus said, 'Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.'

declarations.text: In Christ, righteousness is credited to me through faith. Abraham believed and it was counted to him. I believe and the same transaction stands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The righteousness of God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe.

declarations.text: I stand in grace and I boast in the hope of God's glory. This is not arrogance. This is what justification produces.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand.

declarations.text: God demonstrated His love for me while I was still a sinner. Christ died for me at my worst. That love is irrevocable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

declarations.text: I am reconciled to God through the death of His Son. I live now in the power of His risen life. Reconciliation is my foundation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For if, while we were God's enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!

declarations.text: I reign in life through Jesus Christ. Not scraping by. Reigning. Abundant grace and the gift of righteousness set me above every circumstance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How much more will those who receive God's abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

declarations.text: I am buried with Christ and raised with Him. My old life is entombed. I walk in newness of life, resurrected and reborn.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We were therefore buried with him through baptism into death in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may live a new life.

declarations.text: My old self was crucified with Christ. The body of sin is rendered powerless. I no longer serve sin. That chapter is closed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we know that our old self was crucified with him so that the body ruled by sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.

declarations.text: I offer every part of myself to God as an instrument of righteousness. My hands, my voice, my mind, my will. All surrendered.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and offer every part of yourself to him as an instrument of righteousness.

declarations.text: The wages of sin is death, but God's gift is eternal life through Christ Jesus my Lord. I have received that gift. I am alive.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

declarations.text: I no longer serve God out of obligation to an old code. The Spirit has set me free. I serve in the new way, from a transformed heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now, by dying to what once bound us, we have been released from the law so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit.

declarations.text: The law of the Spirit of life has set me free from the law of sin and death. I operate under a higher law now. Freedom is my jurisdiction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.

declarations.text: The Spirit of God dwells in me. I am not left to my own strength. God Himself lives inside me and that changes everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, however, are not in the realm of the flesh but are in the realm of the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God lives in you.

declarations.text: The same Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in me. That resurrection power animates my mortal body right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies.

declarations.text: I am led by the Spirit of God. That is what it means to be a child of God. I follow His leading without hesitation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.

declarations.text: I have not received a spirit of fear. I have received a spirit of adoption. I cry out Abba, Father. He is mine and I am His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship.

declarations.text: The Spirit Himself confirms it: I am a child of God. Not a stranger. Not a servant. A child, with full standing and full inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God's children.

declarations.text: I am an heir of God and a co-heir with Christ. What belongs to Him belongs to me. I carry the inheritance of the Kingdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now if we are children, then we are heirs — heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ.

declarations.text: My present suffering is not worth comparing to the glory being revealed in me. I endure with clear eyes. The weight of glory outmeasures it all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

declarations.text: God foreknew me. He called me. He justified me. He is glorifying me. Every step in that chain is secure and unbroken.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.

declarations.text: God has chosen me. No one can bring a charge against me that sticks. God is the one who justifies. His verdict is final.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who will bring any charge against those whom God has chosen? It is God who justifies.

declarations.text: Nothing that can afflict me separates me from the love of Christ. Not hardship, not danger, not persecution. I am held.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or hardship or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

declarations.text: I confess with my mouth and believe in my heart. Salvation is sealed in me. I am not hoping for it. I am living in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

declarations.text: The gifts and calling of God on my life are irrevocable. He does not take them back. I press forward in what He ordained.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God's gifts and his call are irrevocable.

declarations.text: God is filling me with joy and peace as I trust Him. I overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. Hope is my atmosphere.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: I am consecrated and set apart as God's holy people. Holiness is not a goal I strain toward. It is the identity I have been given in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people.

declarations.text: I do not lack any spiritual gift. God has fully equipped me as I eagerly await the return of Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

declarations.text: God keeps me firm to the end. I am blameless before Him. His faithfulness holds me and I cannot be shaken.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will also keep you firm to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: God is faithful and He calls me into fellowship with His Son. I am anchored in that calling. Nothing breaks this bond.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is faithful, who has called you into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

declarations.text: The message of the cross is the power of God in me. I am not perishing. I am saved and I carry resurrection power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

declarations.text: What God calls foolish confounds every human calculation. His weakness shatters human strength. I trust His ways above every worldly wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

declarations.text: God chose me. Not because I was the most qualified. Because His choosing makes me qualified. I am His chosen vessel.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

declarations.text: Christ is my wisdom, my righteousness, my holiness, and my redemption. He is my complete sufficiency. I am established in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God, that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

declarations.text: I have received the Spirit of God. He reveals to me what God has freely given me. I walk in the fullness of His gifts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.

declarations.text: I have the mind of Christ. I reason with His wisdom and perceive with His perspective. My mind is renewed and radiant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we have the mind of Christ.

declarations.text: I am God's temple and His Spirit dwells in me. I am not an empty shell. I am a holy dwelling place of the Most High.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in your midst?

declarations.text: I belong to Christ and Christ belongs to God. My identity is rooted in an unbreakable chain of belonging.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And you are of Christ, and Christ is of God.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is not talk. It is power. I do not just speak the faith. I demonstrate it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.

declarations.text: I am washed clean. I am sanctified. I am justified in the name of Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of God. Every stain removed. Every charge dismissed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

declarations.text: I am united with the Lord and I am one spirit with Him. His life flows through me. I am inseparably joined to Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever is united with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

declarations.text: I run my race with purpose. I press toward the prize. I do not drift. I am focused and I finish what God started in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.

declarations.text: By the grace of God I am what I am. His grace toward me is not wasted. I work with all that He has deposited in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect.

declarations.text: I am a new creation. The old has gone. The new is here. I do not drag yesterday into today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

declarations.text: I carry the death of Jesus in my body so that His life is displayed through me. His resurrection power lives in my flesh.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

declarations.text: I do not lose heart. My light and momentary troubles are producing for me an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

declarations.text: I am God's co-worker. He calls me to holiness. I purify myself and complete sanctification in the fear of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

declarations.text: Godly grief produces repentance in me. I do not run from conviction. I let it do its transforming work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

declarations.text: I give generously and cheerfully. God loves a cheerful giver and I am one. My generosity is an act of worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

declarations.text: God supplies seed for me to sow and multiplies what I plant. Every act of generosity I release returns in abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

declarations.text: I do not wage war with worldly weapons. My weapons carry divine power to demolish every stronghold.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

declarations.text: I take every thought captive and make it obedient to Christ. My mind is not a battleground that the enemy controls.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

declarations.text: I boast in the Lord alone. My strength is not my own. My credibility comes from what God has built in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But, 'Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.' For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

declarations.text: His grace is sufficient for me. His power is made perfect in my weakness. I glory in my weakness so Christ's power rests on me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: When I am weak, then I am strong. I have learned this truth and I stand on it without apology.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

declarations.text: I examine myself. I test whether I am in the faith. Christ is in me and I walk in that assurance daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you?

declarations.text: The grace of Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Spirit are mine. I live inside this holy communion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

declarations.text: I walk by faith, not by sight. My steps are not governed by what is visible. I move at the voice of God, not the verdict of my circumstances.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

declarations.text: I am an ambassador for Christ. God makes His appeal through me. I carry His word with authority and conviction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ's behalf: Be reconciled to God.

declarations.text: Christ became sin so I could become the righteousness of God. I stand before the Father fully righteous, fully covered, fully His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

declarations.text: My apostleship does not come from men or through men. It comes from Jesus Christ and God the Father. My calling is God-sourced, not man-approved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by a man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead.

declarations.text: Christ gave Himself for my sins to rescue me from this present evil age. I have been extracted from darkness. I operate in a different realm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father.

declarations.text: False brothers try to spy out my freedom in Christ and drag me back into bondage. I see through every scheme. My freedom is non-negotiable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This matter arose because some false believers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.

declarations.text: I do not set aside the grace of God. Righteousness does not come through the law. If it did, Christ died for nothing. I hold fast to grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!

declarations.text: I received the Spirit by faith, not by works of the law. My spiritual life was born by hearing and believing. That is where I continue.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by believing what you heard?

declarations.text: I did not begin in the Spirit only to finish by the flesh. What God started in me is carried by the same Spirit. I do not revert to striving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Are you so foolish? After beginning by means of the Spirit, are you now trying to finish by means of the flesh?

declarations.text: Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness. I follow that same path of faith. Belief is the currency of my covenant with God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So also Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

declarations.text: Those who walk by faith are the children of Abraham. I am a child of Abraham. Faith is my family lineage. I carry the blessing of the faithful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Understand, then, that those who have faith are children of Abraham.

declarations.text: I am blessed along with faithful Abraham. That blessing is not earned. It is inherited by faith. I receive every facet of the Abrahamic covenant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So those who rely on faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

declarations.text: Christ redeemed me from the curse of the law. He became a curse for me. Every curse is broken over my life. I am redeemed and released.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: 'Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole.'

declarations.text: The blessing of Abraham has come to me through Christ Jesus. I have received the promised Spirit through faith. The covenant blessing is mine today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

declarations.text: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his Seed. That Seed is Christ. I am in Christ. Every promise God made to the Seed belongs to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say 'and to seeds,' meaning many people, but 'and to your seed,' meaning one person, who is Christ.

declarations.text: My inheritance is not based on law. It is based on promise. God gave it to Abraham by promise. That same promise-gift is mine in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on the promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

declarations.text: Scripture locked everything under sin so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ could be given to those who believe. I believe. The promise is mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Scripture has locked up everything under the control of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.

declarations.text: I was once under guardians and trustees, but that time is over. I have come into my full inheritance. I am no longer a minor waiting for permission.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The heir is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

declarations.text: I have come to know God. More than that, I am fully known by God. I do not go back to weak and worthless things. I have tasted true freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now that you know God—or rather are known by God—how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable forces?

declarations.text: I am not a child of the slave woman. I am a child of the free woman. I am born of the promise. My freedom is my birthright in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.

declarations.text: By the Spirit, through faith, I eagerly await the righteousness for which I hope. My hope is not in effort. It is anchored in the Spirit and secured by faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For through the Spirit we eagerly await by faith the righteousness for which we hope.

declarations.text: In Christ, circumcision means nothing and uncircumcision means nothing. What counts is faith expressing itself through love. That is my operating system.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love.

declarations.text: I was called to freedom. I do not use that freedom to indulge the flesh. I use it to serve others through love. Freedom and love are inseparable in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another humbly in love.

declarations.text: The flesh and the Spirit are in conflict. I know this. I choose the Spirit. I side with the Spirit in every battle, and the Spirit prevails in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the flesh desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other.

declarations.text: I belong to Christ Jesus. I have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires. The flesh is nailed to the cross. The Spirit reigns in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

declarations.text: I restore those who stumble with a spirit of gentleness. I watch myself. Restoration is my posture, not judgment. I carry others in humility.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should restore that person gently.

declarations.text: I boast in nothing except the cross of Jesus Christ. Through that cross, the world is crucified to me and I to the world. I am a new creation in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

declarations.text: Circumcision counts for nothing. Uncircumcision counts for nothing. What counts is that I am a new creation in Christ. That is my identity. That is enough.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything; what counts is the new creation.

declarations.text: God calls me to holiness. Not to conform to the world but to be set apart. I walk in that calling with conviction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

declarations.text: The Lord Himself establishes and guards my heart. He is my shield against the evil one. I am protected by His faithfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

declarations.text: I am sober and self-controlled, clothed in faith and love as a breastplate. My helmet is the hope of salvation. I am armored for this day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

declarations.text: God is faithful. He calls me and He completes what He starts in me. My transformation is not my project. It is His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

declarations.text: I encourage others and build them up. This is how I walk worthy of my calling. My words carry life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

declarations.text: God considers me worthy of His calling. He fulfills every good purpose and every act of faith in me by His power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.

declarations.text: The name of Jesus is glorified in me and I am glorified in Him. This is the grace of my God at work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: God gives me eternal encouragement and good hope by His grace. My hope is not fragile. It is established and unshakeable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope.

declarations.text: God chose me from the beginning for salvation through the sanctifying work of the Spirit. I am called and I am sealed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit.

declarations.text: The Lord of peace Himself gives me peace at all times and in every situation. He is present with me. That settles everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

declarations.text: I speak words seasoned with wisdom. My lips are a wellspring of life to those who hear me. I open my mouth with instruction and my tongue teaches what is good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

declarations.text: I fear the Lord and find a wellspring of life within that reverence. His presence is my refuge. I turn from every snare of death and walk in freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.

declarations.text: I open my hand to the poor and extend my arms to the needy. Generosity is my nature. I give freely and I am not impoverished by it. I am enriched.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.

declarations.text: Wisdom is a tree of life in my hands and I hold her fast. Every branch bears fruit. I am blessed because I keep her close and do not let go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.

declarations.text: I receive correction with an open heart. Wisdom enters through reproof. I do not despise discipline. I honor the instruction of God and grow stronger for it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever heeds life-giving correction will be at home among the wise.

declarations.text: I honor the Lord with my wealth and the firstfruits of all I produce. My barns overflow because I give God the first portion. Abundance follows obedience.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops; then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

declarations.text: I listen to counsel and accept instruction. That is the path to wisdom. I do not reject the voice of the wise. I receive it and my understanding deepens.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.

declarations.text: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower and I run to it. I find safety within His name. I am not left exposed. I am secure, sheltered, and unassailable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: I speak what is honest and it stands as enduring testimony. Truth does not need defense. I let my words be a reliable witness and they hold firm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies.

declarations.text: I do not envy sinners. I am zealous for the fear of the Lord all day long. That holy reverence is my anchor and my hope is not cut off.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord. There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

declarations.text: I am a faithful messenger to those who trust me. I bring refreshment to the souls of the people I serve. My reliability is a gift that God has cultivated in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Like a snow-cooled drink at harvest time is a trustworthy messenger to the one who sends him; he refreshes the spirit of his master.

declarations.text: I reject slander and I am not numbered among those who destroy with words. My mouth speaks only what builds. I am a person of proven and tested integrity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever spreads slander is a fool.

declarations.text: I seek wise counsel before every major decision. Plans are confirmed in the company of many advisors. I do not act alone when the stakes are high.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Plans are established by seeking advice; so if you wage war, obtain guidance.

declarations.text: I hold my tongue and preserve my life. The one who speaks without restraint brings ruin. I am measured, deliberate, and precise with my words. That is my wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who guard their lips preserve their lives, but those who speak rashly will come to ruin.

declarations.text: I scatter generously and my wealth increases. I hold nothing back from God's purpose and I am never left wanting. Generosity is the fertile soil of abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

declarations.text: I pursue righteousness and find life, prosperity, and honor waiting for me. I do not cut corners. I run hard after God's standard and He rewards what He sees.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.

declarations.text: Cheerfulness is medicine to my bones and strength to my soul. I choose joy as a discipline. My countenance reflects the life of God dwelling within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

declarations.text: My integrity protects me and guides me. I do not need to manipulate or scheme. Uprightness is my navigator and I arrive at God's best through honest paths.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

declarations.text: I do not return evil for evil. I trust God to vindicate me. He is the one who weighs motives and repays each person according to what they have done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not say, 'I'll pay you back for this wrong!' Wait for the Lord, and he will avenge you.

declarations.text: I seek the Lord early and I find Him. Wisdom calls out at the crossroads and I answer. I am rewarded because I diligently and earnestly search for God's face.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

declarations.text: My words are chosen with care because life and death are at stake. I speak with purpose and precision. What flows from my mouth reflects the treasure of God inside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

declarations.text: I fear the Lord and depart from evil. That is wisdom. That is understanding. I do not chase popular opinion. I pursue the unchanging standard of God's revealed truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

declarations.text: I am a person of genuine friendship. I stay close in adversity. I am the kind of friend who is born for times of difficulty. I do not vanish when it gets hard.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

declarations.text: I incline my ear to wisdom and apply my heart to understanding. I call out for insight. I search for her as for hidden treasure and I find the knowledge of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding, and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure, then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.

declarations.text: I am not moved by the fear of man. I trust in the Lord and I am kept secure. My confidence is not in what people think of me. It is in God who holds me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.

declarations.text: No closed door can stop the fulfillment of the destiny I have prepared for you.
I hold the keys to every door, and I will open the right ones for you.
Closed doors are opportunities for My supernatural intervention in your life.
I am the God of breakthroughs; trust me to break through every closed door for you.
I walk with God, and His blessing rests on the work of my hands.
I am blessed coming in and blessed going out.
I step into my assignment with steady courage. God has already gone ahead of me.
Every morning God sets a fresh assignment in front of me.
I know what God made me for, and I am doing it now.
The right doors open for me at the right time. I walk through them.
I have endurance for the long assignment. God renews my strength every morning.
God goes before me and prepares the way I have not walked yet.
My gifts serve real people and change real lives.
I grow wiser every day, and God builds me to carry what He promised.
I say yes to God before I see the whole plan. He fills in every step.
I run my own race. God set the lane, and I stay in it.
God opens doors for me that no one can shut.
God sends the right people to stand with me and carry the vision.
God funds every vision He gives me. The resources arrive on time.
The Spirit of God speaks inside me, and I hear Him clearly.
I show up every day, and God multiplies what I put my hand to.
What God builds through me outlives me. My children inherit the blessing.
Joy fuels me in the work God gave me. I never run empty.
God's plans for me are good. He designed my whole life on purpose.
God made me on purpose, for a purpose. Nothing about me is an accident.
God gives me everything I need to finish what He assigned me.
Right now I am walking in exactly what God planned for my life.
I take bold steps, and God steadies every one of them.
What God assigned to me is mine. No one else can carry it.
My gift makes room for me. It brings me before great people.
God's favor surrounds me like a shield. It speaks for me before I do.
I do not run on my own strength. God's grace carries the whole assignment.
The Lord sets my steps and makes my path straight.
Every promise God spoke over my life comes to pass. His timing is perfect.
God gives skill to my hands. My work is excellent, and people notice.
God's purpose for my life is being fulfilled through me right now.
I speak up in the rooms God puts me in. My voice carries His authority.
The Lord finishes the good work He started in me.
God has been preparing me for this my whole life. I am ready.
I am complete in Christ. Nothing is missing from what God gave me to do.
I seek first God's kingdom, and everything I need is added to me.
My God supplies all my needs!
I am seated with Christ in heavenly places.
I am God's masterpiece, created for good works He prepared in advance.
I overcome the world through my faith in Jesus.
Christ gives me strength for everything He has called me to do.
Jesus already won. I live from His victory, not toward it.
God chose me before the world began.
I am victorious because of Jesus.
I am more than a conqueror!
I am the head and not the tail.
I am above and never beneath.
As Jesus is, so am I in this world.
No weapon formed against me prospers!
I have the mind of Christ!
My youth is renewed like the eagle's.
I am grateful for a new day!
I am thankful for the vision God planted in me.
I am thankful for eyes that see opportunity and ears that hear God.
I am thankful for a sharp mind that carries God's ideas.
I am thankful for a strong body that can carry the assignment.
God brought me this far, and He is not finished with me.
I tread on lions and cobras. They are crushed under my feet.
This is the day the Lord made. I step into what He created me for.
My words carry authority. I speak to my day, and it lines up.
There is no condemnation for you who believes in me.
Jesus won it all for me. His victory is my starting line.
My future is settled. Heaven is my home, and I live free today.
My name is written in the Book of Life!
The choices I make today build the life God promised me.
I am filled with wisdom, and I know what to do next.
I move in peace and joy through every season.
I bring every decision to God before I make it.
God gives me answers no one else has.
I trust God with the plan for my life.
God is in every detail of my life, down to the smallest one.
I am a warrior!
God's hand holds me steady, and I keep moving forward.
Nothing I face is too big for God.
Today I take one real step toward what God showed me.
God turns my experience into wisdom. I get sharper every year.
I take action today. Faith moves my feet.
I stay teachable. God keeps showing me more.
I take care of my body. It carries me the whole distance.
I love the life God gave me and the road I am on.
Life is a gift. I am thankful for every chapter God writes.
In every season I trust God. He has never missed once.
Abundance is part of my inheritance, and I use it to bless others.
Strong health is part of my inheritance. My body keeps pace with my calling.
Joy and gratitude lift me higher. They are my strength every day.
Jesus gave His life so I could live full and pour into others.
I am confident, faithful, and bold.
I have a clear vision for my life. I write it down and run.
I am alive on purpose today. God still has work for my hands.
I guard my heart, because everything I build flows from it.
God takes pleasure in my prosperity.
I am faithful with what God put in my hands, so He gives me more.
God builds my character to match the size of what He is giving me.
I move when God says move, and I wait when He says wait.
Everything I need to become who God made me is already in me.
My words have power, so I speak only what I want to see.
God and I are partners. He gives the vision, I do the work.
I can change the atmosphere with my words.
I am bold as a lion!
The favor of God rests on me and the work of my hands is established. What I build stands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

declarations.text: God gives me power to produce wealth, and I produce it. The ability is His gift in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your ancestors, as it is today.

declarations.text: I commit this business to the Lord, so my plans succeed. He establishes them, and that settles it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: God began this good work in me and He carries it on to completion. He finishes what He starts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: The Spirit of God fills me with wisdom, knowledge, and every kind of skill. Heaven put it there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills.

declarations.text: I am skilled in my work, so I serve before kings. My craft opens doors no contact could.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you see someone skilled in their work? They will serve before kings; they will not serve before officials of low rank.

declarations.text: I refuse to despise the day of small things. What starts small in my hands finishes great.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who dares despise the day of small things, since the seven eyes of the Lord that range throughout the earth will rejoice when they see the chosen capstone in the hand of Zerubbabel?

declarations.text: The God of heaven gives me success. I am His servant, and I start building.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I answered them by saying, “The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it.”

declarations.text: The Lord builds this house with me, so my labor is never wasted. He guards what I make.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.

declarations.text: I plant the seed and I water it, and God makes it grow. The increase is His work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.

declarations.text: The Lord teaches me what is best and directs my way. I do not guess at this business.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is what the Lord says, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the Lord your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.”

declarations.text: My plans are diligent, and diligent plans lead to profit. This business turns a profit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.

declarations.text: God blesses me abundantly. I have all I need to abound in every good work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: The blessing of the Lord brings me wealth without painful toil. His increase comes clean.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: I am faithful with a few things, so my Master puts me in charge of many.
declarations.bibleVerseText: His master replied, “Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!”

declarations.text: By wisdom I build this house, and through understanding it stands established. God supplies both to me freely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established.

declarations.text: God goes before me and levels the mountains. Gates of bronze open and iron bars give way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will go before you and will level the mountains; I will break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.

declarations.text: I work at it with all my heart because I work for the Lord. This business is worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters.

declarations.text: I plan my course, and the Lord establishes my steps. My direction is secure in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

declarations.text: I am generous, so I prosper. I refresh others, and I am refreshed in return.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

declarations.text: I am planted by streams of water. I yield fruit in season, and whatever I do prospers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither. Whatever they do prospers.

declarations.text: The Lord sends His blessing on everything I put my hand to. My work is blessed by command.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to. The Lord your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.

declarations.text: The Lord is with me and He gives me success in everything I do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,

declarations.text: God delights in my good. My success makes Him glad, so I build without apology.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “The Lord be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant.”

declarations.text: I keep His word in my mouth and on my mind. Then I am prosperous and successful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.
